correctness.rationale: The frozen result defines a centrally symmetric regular dodecahedron, Haar-uniform unoriented central normals, and generic edge crossings. Verified the cone-extreme-ray reduction: every chamber vertex is an oriented pairwise cross product of ten great-circle normals, so the exact-ring script can exhaust 1024 sign masks and 90 rays. Inspection of verify_dodecahedron_haar.py confirms exact Z[phi] sign arithmetic, 12 facet/30-edge validation, absence of triple circle intersections, and the 20 hexagon/60 triangle/12 pentagon chamber certificates; an independent geometric enumeration reproduced the (6,8,10) counts (20,60,12) and the probabilities 0.6384088115593409, 0.2389894688997700, 0.1226017195408904. Girard excess and 4pi normalisation, plus independent expectation 30 beta/pi, establish continuum Haar law, not simulation.
